forecasts.question: Will Likud win the most Knesset seats (seat plurality) in the October 27, 2026 Israeli election?
forecasts.delta_reason: Sunday cold-start audit. Five late-September polls show Eisenkot's Yashar averaging 23.6 seats vs Likud 21.8 (Jerusalem Post, Haaretz Oct 1); Yashar leads in four of five polls. Israel Supreme Court (Oct 2) reinstated Ra'am and Joint List, confirming Arab-party participation. Cold-start p_cold=0.32: base rate party polling ahead at T-25 days wins plurality in 75% of Israeli elections; Yashar leads four of five. Judge partial cold-start credit for DA-flagged war-context incumbency effect and historical right-wing polling undercount. Published p=0.38.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if official Knesset election results published by the Israeli Central Elections Committee show Likud winning more seats than any other single party in the October 27, 2026 election.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Central Elections Committee official results, carried by Times of Israel/Haaretz/Reuters/AP.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Likud and one other party tie on seats: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO (no plurality). Exit polls alone do not resolve; official preliminary results suffice if published before EOD Oct 27.

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session occur before EOD 2026-10-07?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 72h forecast. After UNGA-margin talks (Sep 23) and Iran's Sep 24 roadmap, US Secretary Rubio expelled the Iranian diplomatic delegation. Trump described post-midterm military action as a live option. Pakistan and Qatar channels are intact but no session is scheduled. 72h confirmed session is low-probability given the expulsion of Iranian envoys and publicly hardened positions on both sides.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Reuters, AP, or AFP reports a confirmed meeting — direct or indirect through identified intermediaries — between US and Iranian officials at any level before EOD October 7, 2026. Pure message relay does not count; a named meeting with named participants does.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP wire confirmation, or official statement from either government or named mediator (Qatar, Pakistan, Oman MFA).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Meeting reported but either side later denies it occurred: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Phone calls through intermediaries without face-to-face or direct written exchange: NO.

forecasts.question: Will the United States and Iran announce a formal ceasefire or binding temporary truce before EOD 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 23-day forecast. Talks stalled: Iranian delegation expelled from US territory after UNGA session (Sep 23-24) failed to close gap between Iran's 60-day-halt roadmap and US conditions. Trump described post-midterm military action as live option. Three US carrier groups in theater as of October 3. Previous ceasefire cycles took 4-6 weeks of active talks; 23 days to a binding ceasefire with no session currently scheduled is very low probability.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if both governments (or named senior officials from each side) jointly announce or individually confirm a ceasefire, truce, or hostilities halt of any duration >=24 hours before EOD October 27, 2026.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Official government statement (White House, Iranian Presidency, or MFA) plus Reuters/AP/AFP wire confirmation.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unilateral US announcement without Iranian confirmation, or vice versa: NO. Ceasefire covering Lebanon only without Iran-US component: NO. 'Pause for negotiations' with no specific duration and no named start time: NO.

forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If only one source reports >=20 and others show <20: flag AMBIGUOUS for panel review. US Navy escort convoys excluded from commercial transit count.

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. The Knesset completed its full four-year term and dissolved naturally on July 17, 2026 — the first time since 1988. The coalition maintained a nominal 61/120 majority (one-seat floor) through dissolution after UTJ ministerial withdrawal. Neither YES condition was triggered: no roll-call vote confirmed loss of majority, and dissolution was not 'early' by any standard definition. The YES path is permanently closed; election is Oct 27. DA finding accepted over Analyst's OBE recommendation: the question has a definitive NO answer.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

indicators.expected_effect: +20pp toward YES — path now closed (Knesset dissolved)

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES (forecast underpriced at 0.12). On September 5, 2026, Pakistan brokered a de-escalation: Trump extended the ceasefire and Iran's Supreme National Security Council publicly accepted a two-week halt with a commitment to a second round of talks in Islamabad (Eagle Tribune/AP; JewishLink.news Sep 5). Tasnim ran a same-day denial reflecting IRGC factional split, but the SNSC is the authoritative constitutional body. Resolution criteria met: named Iranian official body (SNSC) issued public statement committing to mediated talks before EOD Sep 6.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, SNSC, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
